Your parking data tells you more than you think.
ParkFlow turns one parking zone into a product shoppers can book: reserve ahead, get verified at the gate, and park in any free bay.
It runs on KLGCC's existing LG level. No new bays, no new building.

A shopper books in the app, and their number plate becomes the pass. For non-members, the booking fee is new income. For members, it's credited to their parking bill, so your best customers keep coming back.
A controller links the cameras, barrier and payments KLGCC already has. New income, no rebuild, and members never pay more than the fee or the bill.
Amber bays are sold to bookings. Green bays keep earning from walk-ins.
The planner holds only what bookings need, so the rest of the zone keeps earning.
At nine, walk-ins fill the zone and pay as normal.
By ten-thirty, bookings are building, so more bays are sold.
A no-show? The fee is kept, and the bay is re-sold. It earns twice.
At noon, every booking is honoured. That trust brings them back.
And every booking becomes a verified visit, read at the gate, with nothing lost.
For the mall operator, the dashboard shows where the money comes from.
Booking fees bring new income. Member credits keep your best customers. And no-shows let the same bay earn twice.
It shows where the zone fills first, so walk-in income isn't lost.
And every decision is logged and measured: the proof to take ParkFlow to the next SDP mall.
